{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from running shell commands that wait for input or never exit.","id":"gh:1420636902","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-block-hanging-commands","slug":"acus9345/dsh-block-hanging-commands","topics":["ai-agents","coding-agent","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","shell"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from running shell commands that wait for input or never e"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"Seek Harness plugin that stops agents from running shell commands that wait for input or never exit."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-block-hanging-commands"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"If you've used an agent for a while you've probably seen this. It runs `git commit` without `-m`, or"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" `npm run dev`, or `python3` with nothing after it, and the turn just sits there. The command is wai"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ting for a keyboard nobody is typing on. Usually the tool times out, the model learns nothing, and t"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"hen it tries something just as bad."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This plugin for DeepSeek Harness reads each shell command before it runs. If the command would wait "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"for input or never exit, it doesn't run it. The model gets told why and what to run instead, so it c"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"an fix the call in the same step."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"That's the `web` profile, the browser UI you start with `dsh web`. If you run DSH another way, use `"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"headless` (scripts and CI) or `acp` (editor integrations) instead. Each profile keeps its own plugin"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" list, so add it to every profile you use. That's all the setup there is. The plugin ships its own p"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"atch layer, so it's on as soon as it's installed."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"To remove it: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-block-hanging-commands`."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### From a clone"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"To try local changes, build a tarball and install that:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What it catches"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Rule | Examples | What the model is told to do instead |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| `editor` | `vim`, `nano`, `emacs`, `code --wait`, `subl -w` | use the edit tools or `sed -i` |
| `"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"git-editor` | `git commit` or `git tag -a` without `-m` | pass `-m` / `--no-edit` |
| `git-interacti"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ve` | `git rebase -i`, `git add -p` | a plain rebase or `--autosquash` with `GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR=:`;"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" `git add <path>` |
| `repl` | `python`, `node`, `psql mydb`, `redis-cli`, `sqlite3 db` | `-c "..."`"},{"id":"p16s5","text":", a script file, or a heredoc |
| `server` | `npm run dev`, `vite`, `next dev`, `flask run`, `rails "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"s` | `run_in_background: true`, or `timeout` |
| `watch` | `jest --watch`, `tsc -w`, `cargo watch`, "},{"id":"p16s7","text":"`nodemon` | run once without the watch flag |
| `follow` | `tail -f`, `journalctl -f`, `kubectl logs"},{"id":"p16s8","text":" -f`, `docker logs -f` | `tail -n 200`, `--since` |
| `remote-shell` | `ssh host` with no command | "},{"id":"p16s9","text":"pass the command; `-o BatchMode=yes` |
| `container-tty` | `docker run -it`, `docker exec -it`, `kub"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"ectl exec -it` | drop `-it` |
| `tui` | `htop`, `top`, `lazygit`, `tig`, `ncdu` | the batch version "},{"id":"p16s11","text":"(`top -bn1`, `git log`) |
| `prompt` / `login` | `npm init` without `-y`, `crontab -e`, `gh auth log"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"in`, `aws configure` | the non-interactive flags, or ask the user |
| `pager`, `tty-prompt` | `less "},{"id":"p16s13","text":"file`, `sudo` asking for a password | only on a PTY shell, see below |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"It looks through the usual wrappers (`sudo`, `env`, `nohup`, `npx`, `pnpm exec`, `uv run`, `bash -c "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"'...'`) and handles pipes, `&&` chains, heredocs and redirects. So `cd app && npm run dev` is caught"},{"id":"p17s3","text":", but `echo q | python3` and `python3 < script.py` are not, because their input is already there. `t"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"imeout 30 npm run dev` gets through, and so does any call made with `run_in_background: true`. In bo"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"th cases the command is going to end or detach anyway. A dev server, watcher or `tail -f` called wit"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"h the shell tool's own `timeoutMs` also gets through, since that bounds it the same way. An editor o"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"r prompt still doesn't, because a timeout just leaves it waiting in the background."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"It works on Windows too, where DSH runs commands through PowerShell (`pwsh`) instead of bash. There "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"it also knows `npm.cmd`, full paths like `C:\Python312\python.exe`, the `&` call operator and `Get-C"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"`npm.cmd`, full paths like `C:\Python312\python.exe`, the `&` call operator and `Get-Content -Wait`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"I tried hard to keep false positives down. `psql -c "select 1"`, `node script.js`, `vim -es`, `git c"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ommit -F msg.txt`, `top -bn1`, `ssh host uptime` and `--help` / `--version` on anything all pass."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Settings"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The easy way: open **Plugins** in DSH's sidebar, click **dsh-block-hanging-commands**, change what y"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ou want and press **Save**. It applies to the next tool call, no restart needed."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Or put a row like this in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`, or in `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.y"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ml` to cover every profile. Keys you leave out keep their defaults."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`pty` matters because without a terminal, `less` and `git log` don't page, and `sudo` fails instead "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"of prompting. So those rules only switch on when the shell really is a PTY."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The plugin hooks `tools/pre-execute`. It tokenises the command itself (no shell is spawned), checks "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"each simple command against the rules, and returns `deny` with the reason text if one matches. Nothi"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ng runs and nothing is rewritten. The model still decides what to do next. It's just deciding with b"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"g is rewritten.
